title: Miniaturized microfluidic-based nucleic acid analyzer to identify new biomarkers of biopsy lung cancer samples for subtyping
summary: A microfluidic RT-LAMP analyzer measured 11 lung-cancer biomarkers in small biopsy samples; a machine-learning model classified subtypes across 86 clinical samples with average AUC 0.934. The result is a bounded single-study diagnostic evaluation, not evidence of improved patient outcomes.
